text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D24) carries a tight ISO fit tolerance on a plated part, but the drawing does not state that plating thickness is allowed for or that the hole will be reamed after plating. Without this allowance the plated hole will be undersize and the intended fit will not assemble. The designer should add a note specifying pre-plate machining limits or post-plate reaming to maintain the H7 fit.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'HOLE TO BE REAMED AFTER PLATING' or specify the pre-plate size accounting for coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies heat treatment hardness but does not state whether it applies before or after machining and surface treatment. For a cylinder rod mount with an H7 hole and plating, applying hardening at the wrong stage can distort machined features or interfere with the coating process. The designer should clarify the sequence, e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-32 HRC PRIOR TO FINAL MACHINING AND SURFACE TREATMENT'.","recommended_correction":"Update N1 to explicitly state the manufacturing stage at which the heat treatment is to be applied."}]}
